title: Fix Admin Dashboard infinite loading after Internet Identity login

requirements.summary: Fix the Admin Dashboard infinite loading state by ensuring proper sequencing of authentication and admin check
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login, navigating to the Admin Dashboard no longer shows an infinite loading spinner.
If the user is an admin, the admin tabs (collections, NFT items) are rendered correctly.
If the admin check call to the backend fails or times out, a clear error message or retry option is shown instead of an infinite spinner.
The fix works in the production (deployed) environment, not just local development.

file_operations.description: Refactor the AdminDashboard component to properly coordinate the authentication state from useInternetIdentity with the admin check from useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout. Ensure the admin check only runs when both the user is authenticated (identity exists) and the actor is ready (not fetching). Add proper error handling for timeout/failure cases with a retry button and clear error message. Replace the infinite loading spinner with a state machine that transitions correctly through: loading authentication → loading admin check → showing admin UI or showing access denied. Add a timeout error UI state that displays when the admin check times out, offering a retry action.

requirements.summary: Ensure the admin check uses an authenticated actor and only fires after identity is fully available
acceptanceCriteria: The isCallerAdmin backend call is only triggered after both the Internet Identity login is complete and an authenticated actor instance is available.
No unauthenticated (anonymous) actor call is made for the admin check when the user is logged in.
The AdminDashboard does not enter an infinite loading state due to the actor not being ready.

file_operations.description: Update the useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook to depend on both the authenticated identity state from useInternetIdentity and the actor readiness from useActor. Ensure the query is only enabled when: (1) identity exists (user is logged in), (2) actor exists (backend connection ready), and (3) actor is not currently fetching. Add explicit guards to prevent the admin check from running with an anonymous or not-yet-ready actor. Improve the timeout mechanism to ensure it properly transitions from loading to timeout state without hanging. Add better error state management that distinguishes between timeout, network error, and authorization failure.
